title: Choose the visual world for Explodenot
question: The roll assigned candidate #5: Control Console & Annunciator Light Panel. Keep it, choose an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Industrial Annunciator & Control Console
options.lineage: Power station control consoles & annunciator alarm light tiles
options.thesis: The quiet confidence of a system running at nominal steady-state: deadpan, backlit, crisis-proof.
options.viewport: A calming illuminated status annunciator panel: ALL SYSTEMS NOMINAL, software that doesn’t go boom.
options.risk: Can veer overly retro-skeuomorphic if the web geometry and type aren’t razor sharp.

raised.raise: Strict high-contrast edge discipline and architectural typographic clarity across all status tiles.

options.label: Aviation Black Box & Flight Recorder Log
options.lineage: Cockpit flight data recorders, accident-prevention telematics
options.thesis: Safety engineering as a calm, unshakeable instrument: survive any crash, diagnose any fault.
options.viewport: An indestructible black box focal unit in pristine safety orange with real-time zero-incident telematics.
options.risk: High familiarity in developer infrastructure branding (observability/metrics dashboard trope).

options.label: Airport Wayfinding & Terminal Gate System
options.lineage: Airport concourse overhead signage and gate guidance
options.thesis: Wayfinding through chaos: massive high-contrast directional signals where failure is not an option.
options.viewport: A stark overhead sign banner directing traffic seamlessly to nominal uptime and owner attribution.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: incident prevention as unambiguous directional clarity.
options.risk: Can feel too institutional if not counterbalanced by Explodenot’s wry humor.

options.label: Warm Humanist Consumer App Surface
options.case: Fails product positioning: software that doesn’t go boom needs industrial technical gravitas, not pastel softness.
options.kept: Strict restriction of accent color solely to actionable elements.

canonCard.label: Modern Tech Inc. Dark Mode
canonCard.thesis: The ubiquitous Vercel/Linear dark developer aesthetic executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Dark centered headline with glowing blue badge and card grid.
canonCard.risk: Entirely indistinguishable from every other developer tool.
